calls.prompt: Edit the attached BugWorld Shared Space UI concept into a sophisticated TRUE MULTI-WINDOW spatial application design. Reference 1 is the accepted warm-white/lilac UI style, NOT the layout to preserve. Reference 2 is the APPROVED EXACT four insect silhouettes, preserve them. Generate a single landscape high-fidelity 2560x1600 concept view in a softly blurred neutral real room. Use FOUR physically separate floating WindowContainers with clear air gaps and visible room between every window: (A) CENTER large drawing window; (B) TOP separate slim horizontal species/navigation BAR directly above center window, separated by visible empty air; (C) RIGHT separate narrow tall paint tools window beside the central canvas with a generous clear gap; (D) LEFT separate artwork-album window opened beside the central canvas with a generous clear gap. NO large enclosing frame, NO common glass background behind all windows, NO web dashboard and no sidebars attached to the canvas. All four surfaces have coordinated luminous frosted warm-white borders, subtle lilac accents, rounded corners, tidy precise controls and comfortable pointer target sizes. Composition should visibly read as four independently movable spatial windows centered in front of the user, side windows slightly turned inward, central window straight on. Main canvas is most important. Top BAR content left to right EXACTLY: delicate butterfly outline logo + 'BugWorld', four compact insect icon selectors (butterfly, side-profile horn beetle, oval ladybug, long caterpillar), and at far right album icon plus '作品册'. Butterfly selected in pale lilac. The upper bar contains no color controls or extra navigation tabs. CENTER window: only a large warm ivory square paper with approved reference butterfly (very broad upper wings, dark outer upper corner patches, softly scalloped lower wings, edge dots, slender body, no face), partially colored pink/lavender using realistic irregular wax-crayon deposits, grain, directional strokes and white paper pores. Tiny '蝴蝶' and '草稿已保存' at top of canvas. Main window bottom contains three clearly spaced buttons '保存', '看看它', primary lilac '送到大自然'; a small quiet '去花园' text link can sit at left edge of footer. No species list or tools on the canvas. RIGHT tools window: small heading '画具' and close icon, icon row '蜡笔' selected, '填色', '橡皮'; 12 circular harmonious color swatches; brush width slider '粗细'; small intensity control '轻重'; '对称绘画' toggle; undo and redo icons. LEFT album window: heading '作品册', close icon, clean two by two grid of four paper thumbnails of the approved insects with different gentle crayon colors; bottom preview of selection with '继续画' secondary and '放入花园' action, a discreet delete icon; not a list of arbitrary photos. Place a small coherent THREE-DIMENSIONAL butterfly painted exactly like the central canvas, hovering in front of lower-right portion of CENTRAL window, clearly forward of its plane with body thickness and open hinged wings, in the empty spatial gap before the right toolbox, without blocking any controls. Two tiny rotate / close controls underneath it. This butterfly is NOT another rectangular window and is not inside the color tools. Maintain gracious negative space, calm mature visual language, beautifully crisp accurate Chinese typography. Caption bottom left outside windows 'Shared Space · 多窗口创作工作台', bottom right '布局评审 v2'. No bounding boxes, arrows, technical labels, giant drop shadows, purple slabs or fullscreen stage environment. Strictly preserve four clearly detached containers and the requested order of top-bar elements.

Create a refined landscape 2048x1400 MATERIAL TARGET BOARD for a digital wax-crayon painting tool in BugWorld. This is a VISUAL TARGET sample, NOT a screenshot of implemented software. Macro-realistic dry traditional wax crayon on softly textured warm-white uncoated drawing paper. Show convincing colored wax physically catching the raised paper grain, white irregular pores remaining in the valleys, clustered tiny wax pigment flakes, directional striations and softly chipped irregular stroke edges. It MUST look like wax crayon: not watercolor wash, chalk dust, pastel smudging, colored-pencil thin hatch only, smooth marker fill, paintbrush bristle paint or random pixel noise. Elegant editorial layout with lots of whitespace, readable muted-charcoal Chinese captions. Top heading 'BugWorld · 蜡笔质感目标'. Top row contains 3 large rose-colored broad diagonal back-and-forth stroke patches of the SAME crayon on SAME paper, labeled '轻涂', '叠涂', '厚涂': light shows open paper texture and broken coverage; repeated passes naturally accumulate richer wax retaining fine grain; heavy becomes saturated denser wax with small specular wax flecks and only tiny remaining pores, no harsh digital cutoff. Middle row two generous examples: on left crossed pink and periwinkle crayon strokes showing subtle layered color and separate directional marks where they overlap, label '交叉叠色'; on right thin-to-wide curved lavender crayon marks with continuous motion, naturally variable edges, no circular stamp beads, label '连续笔触'. Bottom right show one close cropped portion of the APPROVED butterfly from reference with its dark curved wing boundary and edge dots and meticulous pink/lilac wax coloring confined inside, uncolored adjacent wing paper visible; preserve the butterfly drawing proportions, do not draw a new butterfly species. Bottom left a large magnified circular inset of paper-to-wax microtexture with tiny title '纸纹与蜡粒' and one clear thin connector to the sample, no scientific fake measurements. Small footer '视觉目标样张 · 非应用运行效果'. Use the attached insect board only for the butterfly outline; all other artwork is the material study. No crayons, hands, commercial brands, interface controls, watermarks, comparison to existing software, incorrect claim of implementation, or illegible paragraphs. High-end art-material photographic fidelity, cohesive physically plausible paper texture, natural hand-applied wax strokes.

Precisely revise the attached approved-layout BugWorld multi-window concept, preserving ALL four detached windows, their positions relative to each other, exact interface labels, warm-white/lilac styling, butterfly canvas, top bar order, left album and right tools unchanged. ONE specific composition correction: the floating 3D butterfly currently occludes the canvas action buttons and right-hand controls. Keep it visibly volumetric and in front of the central canvas plane, but its entire silhouette and both small controls must have clear empty-air separation from the '送到大自然' button, all other canvas footer buttons, and the whole right tools window. Allow a little more neutral room space below the windows by expanding the image vertically at the bottom if needed; do not shrink UI or alter its layout to fit the butterfly. Keep small bottom-left 'Shared Space · 多窗口创作工作台' and bottom-right '布局评审 v2', moved down if canvas extends. No arrows, annotations, new windows, or added features. Target a clean unoccluded practical spatial workspace, with the model foreground below the central canvas-right corner.
